confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use aggregated, partly crowd-sourced 2025-2026 Cluj-Napoca price data (Numbeo Oct 2026, Expatistan Nov 2026, world-prices Jun 2026, Livingcost Nov 2025, Wise 2026 pages), used as a proxy for July 2026; some sources run much lower. Cocktail and wine rest on thin, mixed listings and were sanity-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 1.5x beer). Local prices were converted to USD at approximate 2026 rates. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation search was run and no live listings or availability were checked. The FX value of 0.6720 for 2026-11-18 came from search results (a third-party headline and a summary citing RBA pages); the rba.gov.au page was not opened directly, and no 19 November observation was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors reflect Cluj-specific aggregated price sources. Accommodation anchors are a holistic estimate from general knowledge of other large Romanian cities and Cluj's summer tourism demand, not checked against live listings.
